The Dolly Glass Pumpkin | Best Sellers | best seller, breast cancer awareness, Fall Harvest Collection, gift, hand blown, hand-blown glass pumpkin, New Releases, Pumpkin, seasonal | Living loud, giving big, and shining bright – The Dolly is our most glamorous Breast Cancer Awareness pumpkin to date. Inspired by Dolly Parton’s signature style, philanthropic heart, and famous motto, “there ain’t nothing a little sparkle can’t fix,” this limited-edition piece brings stunning beauty and meaningful impact directly into your home. Each pumpkin is one-of-a-kind, created using an elaborate multi-step color application. Before we even begin making the pumpkin, we blow rondels, each a mix of gold ruby, pink, and magenta, that become a painter’s palette of color. The rondels are broken into smaller pieces, reheated, and carefully layered onto the white glass bubble that becomes the foundation of the pumpkin. And because that still wasn’t enough, we add another layer of sparkling dichroic glass that catches the light in flashes of pink, gold, and rainbow brilliance. Then we finish her with a dramatic golden ringlet stem, reminiscent of Dolly’s iconic blond hair. Each pumpkin is hand-engraved with our signature, the year, and its individual edition number, then finished with gold fill for a radiant, lasting mark of authenticity. Created as a limited edition, The Dolly will never be reproduced. Crafted in support of Pink Fund®, The Dolly honors the strength and resilience of those whose lives have been touched by breast cancer, proving that beauty and action go hand-in-hand. Because when you’re going to make a difference, you might as well shine while doing it.
